The House Bill 249 By: Representatives Dickey of Committee on Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications offers the 134th, Anderson of the 10th, Huddleston of the 72nd, Drenner of the 85th, and Campbell of the 171st following substitute to HB 249:
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 1 of Chapter 3 of Title 46 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to generation and distribution of electricity generally, so as to revise provisions relating to solar power facility agreements; to revise provisions relating to the waiver of certain requirements of such agreements; to provide for the certification by authorize the Environmental Protection Division of the Department of Natural Resources that solar power facility agreements meet certain requirements; to issue cease and desist orders; to provide civil penalties; to provide an exception; to revise and provide for definitions; to provide for an effective date; to provide for related matters; to repeal conflicting laws; and for other purposes.
BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF GEORGIA:

SECTION 2. This Act shall become effective upon its approval by the Governor or upon its becoming law without such approval.
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
